title: 第25章 小徒弟半夜敲门吃玉手的江魔头第26章 师尊想看就直说又没说不给你看
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
待大徒弟换了身新的衣服后，江尘羽操控灵力将三双筷子递到了三位女弟子们的身边：
“吃吧，这些菜都是都是好的！”
“师尊，这......这太贵重了，我们真的能吃吗？”
李鸾凤瞥了一眼餐桌上的两道大菜，眼皮顿时跳了好几下。
她与独孤傲霜都是有见识的人群，所以自然知道这一顿饭的价值可能会高得惊人。
“当然，要是不给你们吃我拿出来干啥，耍你们吗？”
“我还没有那么无聊！”
江尘羽摆了摆手，随后示意她们动筷子。
而哪怕是看见了他的动作，李鸾凤与林诗钰都还是没敢动筷子，只是不住地吞咽着唾沫。
“吃，都快点吃，你们要是不舍得吃，我就全都自己一个人吃了！”
独孤傲霜的胆子是三人中最大的。
哪怕刚刚才被江尘羽狠狠地教训过一番，但是她还是没有丝毫的胆怯，而是立即动筷朝着晶莹剔透的青玉鱼的鱼肉夹去。
待将鱼肉吃进肚子的瞬间，她的呼吸都不禁急促了几分。
‘虽然不想承认，但这确实是我吃过最好吃的鱼！’
恶狠狠地瞪了江尘羽一眼，大徒弟将目光放在了另一盘菜上。
“诗钰，你先吃菜就好了，至于肉等我夹给你你再吃！”
林诗钰的修为太低了，像青玉鱼以及返虚境牛妖的肉对于她而言太补了！
吃一两块的话，她还能凭借着先天道体的特殊性强扛过去。
但若是吃得多了，那是铁定要落得爆体身亡的下场的！
看着江尘羽正贴心地为自己化解肉类里边的灵力，林诗钰的眼眶都有些微微发酸。

毕竟，她虽然出生于富贵人家，但却是家中不大受宠的那一位。
不然家里人也不可能在江魔头开出丰厚条件后，迫不及待地将她给送出去。
“喏，吃吧，这盘子里的都是处理好的。
虽然有些浪费里边的灵力，但是几百年一次，偶尔奢侈一把也没关系！”
江尘羽将盘子里的肉给端到小徒弟的旁边，随后揉了揉她的小脑袋。
“诶，你怎么还哭了？”
瞥见少女眼角掉落的泪珠，江尘羽顿时就有些手足无措。
他清楚，此时少女的哭泣对于他而言是一个友善的讯号。
但是，他并不想让她在这么开心的时候眼角淌出泪水。
“师尊太坏了，居然连小孩子都不放过！”
独孤傲霜看着江尘羽的动作，语气幽幽然地说道。
content_en:
After the eldest disciple changed into new clothes, Jiang Chenyu controlled his spiritual power and handed three pairs of chopsticks to the three female disciples:
"Eat, these dishes are all good!"
"Master, this... this is too expensive, can we really eat it?"
Li Luanfeng glanced at the two dishes on the table, and her eyelids jumped several times.
She and Dugu Aoshuang are both knowledgeable people, so they naturally know that the value of this meal may be astonishingly high.
"Of course, if I don't feed you, why would I take it out? Are you kidding me?"
"I'm not that bored yet!"
Jiang Chenyu waved his hand and then motioned for them to use their chopsticks.
Even after seeing his movements, Li Luanfeng and Lin Shiyu still didn't dare to move their chopsticks, they just kept swallowing their saliva.
"Eat, eat quickly. If you are not willing to eat, I will eat them all by myself!"
Dugu Aoshuang is the most courageous among the three.
Even though she had been severely taught by Jiang Chenyu just now, she still did not show the slightest fear and immediately moved her chopsticks towards the flesh of the crystal clear green jade fish.
The moment she took the fish into her stomach, her breathing quickened.
‘I don’t want to admit it, but this is indeed the best fish I’ve ever eaten! ’
After giving Jiang Chenyu a vicious look, the eldest disciple turned his attention to another plate of food.
"Shi Yu, just eat the vegetables first. As for the meat, you can eat it after I give it to you!"
Lin Shiyu's cultivation level is too low, and the meat of green jade fish and the return-to-virtue-level bull demon are too filling for her!
If she eats just one or two pieces, she can still bear it with the special characteristics of her innate Tao body.
But if you eat too much, you will definitely end up exploding to death!
Seeing Jiang Chenyu caringly dissolving the spiritual power in the meat for him, Lin Shiyu's eyes felt a little sore.
After all, although she was born into a wealthy family, she was the least favored one in the family.
Otherwise, the family would not have been able to wait to send her away after Devil Jiang offered generous terms.
"Here, eat, everything on this plate has been taken care of.
Although it's a bit of a waste of the spiritual power inside, it doesn't matter if you have an occasional luxury once every few hundred years! "
Jiang Chenyu brought the meat on the plate to the side of his little apprentice, and then rubbed her little head.
"Hey, why are you still crying?"
Seeing the tears falling from the corners of the girl's eyes, Jiang Chenyu was immediately at a loss.
He knew that the girl's cry at this time was a friendly signal to him.
However, he didn't want tears to flow from the corners of her eyes when she was so happy.
"Master is so evil, he doesn't even let children go!"
Dugu Aoshuang looked at Jiang Chenyu's movements and said in a quiet tone.
